pages.text: 160 HP, roams Basalt Deltas and Molten Glass Lakes. A $(l)ground slam$() announced by a cloud of dust, volleys of $(l)magma chunks$() at range, half damage from projectiles. Below 50% its core melts: faster, it sets attackers on fire. Drops the $(item)Basalt Heartstone$(), needed for the Sealed Heart.

Every attack is announced and can be countered:$(li)$(l)Ground slam$(): a shockwave rolls outward; $(l)jump$() over it.$(li)$(l)Charge$(): he rears up and roars, then rushes in a straight line. Dodge sideways: if he hits a wall he is $(l)stunned$() and takes more damage.$(li)$(l)Eruptions$(): bubbling magma circles appear under you, then columns of fire burst out: move!$(li)$(l)Magma chunks$() at range.
pages.title: Attaques
